profile.summary: School Health is a national company that sells health supplies and related services to school professionals, from pre-school through college. Its products include first aid and diagnostic supplies, sports medicine items, special education resources, physical education equipment and emergency preparedness items. It has operated since 1957.

review.notes: School Health Corporation, 5600 Apollo Drive, Rolling Meadows, IL matches the agenda name and location, and sells special education resources, which fits the Special Education Department MOU. About-us and contact pages confirm legal name, 1957 founding, pre-school through college customers, product categories, phone, generic customer-service email and address; the summary is neutral.
